title: deploymentWorktree
responsibility: Runs deployment work in an isolated checkout of an immutable commit and removes that checkout afterward.

inputs.name: deploymentWorktree.root
inputs.description: Absolute Git repository directory whose source and deployment receipts are inspected.

inputs.name: deploymentWorktree.commit
inputs.description: Full immutable source commit to check out for deployment.

inputs.name: deploymentWorktree.work
inputs.description: Async deployment operation invoked with the isolated source checkout directory.

outputs.name: deploymentWorktree
outputs.description: Result of the async operation after its temporary checkout is cleaned up.
